seo.title: MB Fret Services – Sea Freight France–Congo & France–Angola | FCL & LCL Containers
seo.description: French B2B freight forwarder with 15+ years of experience, specialised in the France–Congo and France–Angola corridors. Sea freight in 20' and 40' containers (FCL/LCL), international moves, vehicle and motorbike shipping, maritime groupage, customs clearance and cargo insurance for your import‑export projects.

valueProps.title: Why choose MB Fret Services?
valueProps.subtitle: France‑based Europe–Africa B2B freight forwarder with an operational focus on Central Africa (Congo, Angola). We combine sea freight, customs clearance and cargo insurance to build clear, sustainable, tailor‑made solutions for your flows, from quote to delivery.

items.title: Sea Freight
items.description: Sea freight from France and Europe to Central Africa (Congo, Angola) with FCL containers and LCL groupage for international moves, vehicles and B2B cargo, with real‑time tracking.

items.title: Customs clearance
items.description: Import/export customs clearance between France/Europe and Africa for your FCL/LCL containers, with document control, duties & taxes calculation and Incoterms guidance.

items.title: Cargo insurance
items.description: Ad valorem insurance for your containers (international moves, B2B cargo, vehicles, motorbikes) to Congo and Angola, integrated into your quotes for a clear view of total delivered cost.

destinations_subtitle: We primarily serve Central Africa (Congo, Angola) from France and Europe, with solutions tailored to international moves, vehicles and B2B cargo.
destinations_need_specific: Need a specific destination? We assess all requests.
final_cta_text: Get a personalized quote in under 24 hours. Our experts analyse your needs to propose a reliable transport solution, with market‑aligned pricing and support at every step of your logistics project.
